courses.role: Babysitting course incl. paediatric first aid

exp.desc: - Twins aged four, once or twice a week

cl.p1: your note on the board at the community centre caught my eye, and I would love to look after your two children. I am 16 and this spring I completed a babysitting course that included paediatric first aid.
cl.p2: For the past year I have regularly looked after our neighbours’ twins, who are four. Stories, tea, teeth, and then waiting until both are asleep – I know the routine well. I am free until 10 pm on weekdays and later at weekends.
cl.p3: Mrs Kaur, our neighbour, is happy to give you a reference.

cl.p1: the hours between school pick-up and the end of the working day are often the hardest for parents – my sister tells me so every week. I am a second-year education student and could collect your son from school on Tuesdays and Thursdays and stay until six.
cl.p2: I have been a youth group leader for five years. Homework, football in the park and cooking something simple together are things I enjoy and do reliably. I already hold an enhanced background check for my volunteering.
